title: Rewrite for an audience
summary: Rewrite a text for a stated audience, keeping every fact.

inputs.text: Patients must fast for 8 hours before the procedure at 9:30 on 4 June. Bring your Medicare card.
hey team, server's down till 3, sorry!

sections.use: Rewrite a text for another audience or tone, such as plain English for a patient or a formal notice for customers, keeping all its facts.
sections.exclusions: Not a translation (use translate_text) and not a summary (use summarise_document).
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 6,144 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Text up to 20,000 characters; instruction up to 500.
sections.missing_data: An empty text gives an empty result.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

inputs.instruction: How to rewrite it, for example the audience or tone.
